author: Totally Not Mark
description:
With the help of Ragatha's own voice actor, Amanda Hufford, I jump into The Amazing Digital Circus for the very first time to try and uncover its mysteries! But as it turns out, the mysteries are found within. With the finale to this tale on the horizon, I'm gonna need to fully understand the likes of Pomni, Ragatha, Caine, Kinger, and every other character if I have any hope of cracking this in time! 

Ragatha - Amanda Hufford - https://x.com/JustTheClippy

Catch the next part the second it's ready: https://www.patreon.com/totallynotmark
title: Okay... The Amazing Digital Circus is Crazy Good (feat. Ragatha)
